title: Before and after, v0.1.280: Algarve Evolution as a mini-site
summary: The Algarve Evolution page for Dinis's meeting at 15:00: the reading-column page of v0.1.269 against dev.portugal@'s wide mini-site, live at v0.1.280 (its deploy waited from 14:20), and the designer's mock-up as the next step.

steps.label: After: v0.1.280
steps.note: dev.portugal@'s mini-site: the page uses the full width, a left-hand map of the sections, the figures as tiles, a timeline from 2018 to 2027 with the 2019 launch and the 2024 presidency, programme cards and the interactive network, timeline and map.

steps.label: Next: the designer's mock-up
steps.note: What is still to take from the design: a full-bleed hero band; the mandate said once; the 2032 goals in a row of their own, apart from what is done; on a phone, the map as a sticky row and sections collapsed.

notes: Built in one sprint at Dinis's word (14:10): dev.portugal@ built it, dev.graphs@ the interactive graph, the researcher the past, the designer the mock-up and six fixes (board/spec-algarve-evolution-fixes-1420.md).
Live from v0.1.280: fixes 1 (wide) and 4 (the map) in part; 2 (say the mandate once), 3 (goals apart from what is done), 5 (one-line programme cards) and 6 (no floating Ask) still to do.
The deploy stalled from v0.1.269 (14:20) to after 14:45; the page was not live for the start of the meeting.
